name: I Am Night Club Manager
summary:
I Am Nightclub Manager puts you in control of building, running, and expanding a successful nightclub in VR. Step into the role of a club manager and experience the challenges of real nightclub management, where every decision affects your business, reputation, and crowd satisfaction.
